races.name: Skytree Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
WAAQED should build on his Newmarket debut and is preferred to Kempton fourth Burningringoffire, although there are some likely sorts among the newcomers, notably Royal Authority and Ralph Beckett pair Vestre Moon and Iron Curtain.

  1. WAAQED (IRE)
  2. BURNINGRINGOFFIRE (IRE)
  3. ROYAL AUTHORITY (IRE)

races.name: MJG Group Handicap
races.verdict:
Cases can be made for several, but the vote goes to the unexposed BOLD SHOUT who can gain a second C&D success. Pull The Rug has not had much luck of late and is entitled to be thereabouts granted the rub of the green, while Red Snapper should make a bold bid to extend his recent winning streak.

  1. BOLD SHOUT (IRE)
  2. PULL THE RUG (IRE)
  3. RED SNAPPER

races.name: PKF Francis Clark Handicap
races.verdict:
THE QUIET GENT returned from a 10-month absence (gelded during that time) with a solid second starting out for a new yard at Brighton 5 weeks ago and, with fewer miles on the clock than plenty in this field, is given the chance to build on that with first-time cheekpieces now enlisted. Sergeant Pep, Baldomero and the hat-trick seeking Safari Dream head the dangers, along with Tenbob Tommy in a competitive affair.

  1. THE QUIET GENT (IRE)
  2. SERGEANT PEP (IRE)
  3. BALDOMERO (IRE)

races.name: Happy 40th Birthday Kevin Baker Selling Stakes
races.verdict:
Recent nursery winner ABSOLUTE DIAMOND looks the form and can follow up at the expense of Lushill and Persian Land, in that order.

  1. ABSOLUTE DIAMOND (IRE)
  2. LUSHILL (IRE)
  3. PERSIAN LAND (IRE)

races.name: Weatherbys Stallion Book Persian Punch Conditions Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Most of these having something to prove at present but AMILOC has some strong pieces of form to his name from last year and can take advantage of the marked drop in class. Quickthorn, a dual winner of this, appeals as next best, ahead of Lion's Pride.

  1. AMILOC
  2. QUICKTHORN
  3. LION'S PRIDE

races.name: Hendy Land Rover Handicap
races.verdict:
This may prove a good test at the trip and that should benefit MISS GUINEVERE who can open her account. Scarlet Letter may do better now handicapping, whileTakeitorleaveit has obvious place claims if bouncing back from a lesser effort at Ffos Las.

  1. MISS GUINEVERE (IRE)
  2. SCARLET LETTER (IRE)
  3. TAKEITORLEAVEIT (IRE)

meeting_summary.going: Good to soft-good in places on round course

races.name: Sporting Times EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This looks a good opportunity for Group 1-entered IVORY MOON to make it 2-2. Rapid Deployment and Perfect Strike remain open to improvement, the former preferred as the main danger with his latest fifth having worked out well.

  1. IVORY MOON (IRE)
  2. RAPID DEPLOYMENT (FR)
  3. PERFECT STRIKE (FR)

races.name: Visit Sri Lanka Handicap
races.verdict:
An open-looking sprint. HINT OF HUMOUR may be poised to land a first turf success following a creditable C&D third 2 weeks ago. Isle Of Lismore ought to go well from stall 1 under the returning Billy Loughnane (1-1), with 3-y-o filly Always Perfect not discounted in a field of largely exposed sprinters.

  1. HINT OF HUMOUR
  2. ISLE OF LISMORE (IRE)
  3. ALWAYS PERFECT (IRE)

races.name: Sporting Times/Sri Lanka Awaits You EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
HALDON PIER ticks plenty of boxes on paper (half-sister won on debut for this yard last year) and may be able to make a winning start. She's narrowly preferred to standard-setter Empress Jingu, while Must Be Love is another newcomer to be taken seriously, especially if supported.

  1. HALDON PIER
  2. EMPRESS JINGU
  3. MUST BE LOVE

races.name: Sporting Times/Sri Lanka Nursery (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
NORHAM created a good impression when going in at Lingfield on just his second run and is fancied to follow up off an attractive mark now quickly stepping into nursery company. Tiora Time also looks to have better days ahead of her and is feared most on her handicap bow, although both Clive The Writer and Duke Of Burgundy can play a prominent role too.

  1. NORHAM (IRE)
  2. TIORA TIME
  3. CLIVE THE WRITER (IRE)

races.name: Sri Lanka Paradise Island Handicap
races.verdict:
Richard Hannon's entire CHRISTIAN DAVID has slipped to an attractive mark and is fancied to gain a deserved first win of 2026 after a run of good efforts. Philanthropist is feared most on the back of a resurgent Kempton second with Gary and Josh Moore's new recruit Zabeel Alkabeir also in the mix.

  1. CHRISTIAN DAVID (IRE)
  2. PHILANTHROPIST
  3. ZABEEL ALKABEIR (IRE)

races.name: Sri Lanka Wonder Of Asia Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
DREAM VEGA got off the mark in impressive fashion at Chester last time and can follow up now switched to handicaps. Fellow handicap debutante Vanilla Skies is most feared, with Lyra Lea completing the 1-2-3.

  1. DREAM VEGA (IRE)
  2. VANILLA SKIES
  3. LYRA LEA

races.name: Sporting Times Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
MOLO DEL PALAZZO caught the eye despite finding plenty of things go against her at Goodwood last time and she can get off the mark. Del Corso found his run of progression coming to a halt last time but remains with solid place claims, along with Mr Seagull, whose mark continues to ease.

  1. MOLO DEL PALAZZO (USA)
  2. DEL CORSO
  3. MR SEAGULL (IRE)

races.name: Neaves & Co EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
BEARLY BLUE is already proven with plenty of give underfoot and is well drawn to go forward from stall 1, so could be the way to go back from a break. Donna Beauty needs to prove more tractable but is a big player if doing so, with He's Readytorumble another to consider with first-time cheekpieces enlisted.

  1. BEARLY BLUE (IRE)
  2. DONNA BEAUTY (IRE)
  3. HE'S READYTORUMBLE

races.name: Virgin Bet A Good Bet Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
DOVECOTE has shown fair form when runner-up in consecutive maidens and can go one better in a shallow contest for his top yard. She's Too Kool has run well in recent maidens despite remaining winless after 9 starts and looks the danger.

  1. DOVECOTE
  2. SHE'S TOO KOOL (IRE)
  3. LAHAN KINGMAN (IRE)

races.name: HRS Cladding Handicap
races.verdict:
MEET ME IN MERAKI was the subject of a late gamble and may well have rewarded his backers had he seen daylight earlier when just touched off by reopposing Zambezi Magic at Chepstow 11 days ago. Evidently down to a handy mark, he can confirm the promise of that run. Condotti back at a more suitable trip and Chilly Breeze head up the dangers, with Ayr scorer West Tyrone and Risk Averse Rebel just another couple to factor in.

  1. MEET ME IN MERAKI
  2. CONDOTTI (IRE)
  3. CHILLY BREEZE

races.name: Virgin Bet Daily Price Boosts Handicap
races.verdict:
BAKER BLUE has been running well in competitive sprint handicaps this year and has all the hallmarks of one that should be suited by this track so he's taken to prove too speedy for the thriving Aces Wild and 8-time course winner Roman Dragon, neither of whom are ideally berthed.

  1. BAKER BLUE
  2. ACES WILD (IRE)
  3. ROMAN DRAGON

races.name: TMT Group Handicap
races.verdict:
TWO COMMANDERS was well served by the return to this trip and looked one to keep on side when doubling his tally at Musselburgh 18 days ago. A 3 lb rise certainly doesn't look insurmountable and he's fancied to follow up from a handy draw. Karl Burke's French recruit Scutari and Dublin Bay are a couple of the chief dangers.

  1. TWO COMMANDERS
  2. SCUTARI
  3. DUBLIN BAY (IRE)

races.name: Virgin Bet Daily Extra Places Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
LADY GORMIRE had been held back by racing too freely but settled better when off the mark under a positive ride at Catterick 16 days ago. She's well drawn to employ the same tactics here and could dominate matters. So Sassy won back-to-back handicaps on all-weather at Wolverhampton recently and is thriving but now switches to turf, whilst Sugar Sugar merits respect if she's in the mood.

  1. LADY GORMIRE (IRE)
  2. SO SASSY (IRE)
  3. SUGAR SUGAR (IRE)

races.name: Inkerman London Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
CASCADE HALL ran really well up against a thriving rival just last week and looks well in racing from effectively a 1 lb lower mark so he's taken to resume winning ways back up to a trip that suits. The 3-y-o Sir Griflet could prove best of the rest up against much more exposed rivals, while the veteran Bollin Neil returned in good heart recently and should continue in form.

  1. CASCADE HALL (IRE)
  2. SIR GRIFLET (IRE)
  3. BOLLIN NEIL

races.name: Betfred Flying Scotsman Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
ROCK MONTREAL looks open to any amount of improvement on the back of his comfortable Yarmouth debut success and can claim the scalp of owner-mate Nabati, whose close second to Arapaho Gold at Newbury sets the standard on form. Andrew Balding's impressive debut winner Forbidden Fire is also highly respected.

  1. ROCK MONTREAL (IRE)
  2. NABATI (IRE)
  3. FORBIDDEN FIRE

races.name: Betfred Leger Legends Classified Stakes (Str)
races.verdict:
Sammy Jo Bell has a strong record in this race, with 3 wins since 2019, and ANTHROPOLOGIST might be able to provide her with another success. This 4-y-o has raced mainly on all-weather since joining Michael Herrington but won on turf during his time with Charlie Johnston. This trip could be on the limit of Caragio's stamina but trainer-jockey Adam Kirby might have had this race in mind for him for a while and he's second choice ahead of Wield, the mount of recently retired Joe Fanning.

  1. ANTHROPOLOGIST
  2. CARAGIO (IRE)
  3. WIELD

races.name: Carlsberg Danish Pilsner Flying Childers Stakes (Group 2)
races.verdict:
Although he came up short in the Richmond at Glorious Goodwood it's potentially significant that FLANN SUNNA went off at such a short price in that Group 2 contest and he's given another chance to show what he can do at this level. Final Objective ran a cracker in the Gimcrack and is second choice ahead of Molecomb winner Pershaada and Morny runner-up Carry The Flag.

  1. FLANN SUNNA (IRE)
  2. FINAL OBJECTIVE (IRE)
  3. PERSHAADA (IRE)

races.name: Betfred Howard Wright Doncaster Cup Stakes (Group 2)
races.verdict:
QUEENSTOWN looks interesting in receipt of 5 lb from dual Group 1 winner Caballo de Mar (who hasn't fired on his last couple of starts), and he's taken to give Aidan O'Brien a first success in this race since 2008. Top-end handicapper Ascending appeals as a sporting each-way bet at the forecast prices, in what hardly looks a stellar renewal.

  1. QUEENSTOWN (IRE)
  2. CABALLO DE MAR (IRE)
  3. ASCENDING (IRE)

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Premier Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
The rapidly progressive SILVER LAKE did particularly well to score at York last time and the 4-timer looks on the cards for the William Haggas-trained grey. Nochebuena's Ascot form looks strong and she can improve further on just her second handicap outing, with the similarly-improving Ruby Wedding also making plenty of appeal in a hot-looking race.

  1. SILVER LAKE
  2. NOCHEBUENA
  3. RUBY WEDDING

races.name: Coopers EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The betting should reveal plenty but VICTORIA NIGHT shaped well under a considerate ride when runner-up at Sandown on debut and can use that experience to telling effect to go one better here. Karl Burke's Lope de Vega filly She's Got A Way is bred to be useful and could emerge as the main danger.

  1. VICTORIA NIGHT (IRE)
  2. SHE'S GOT A WAY (IRE)
  3. ANTONOVA

races.name: Tanbry Construction Nursery
races.verdict:
PRIDE OF TOLEDO remains a potentially useful prospect, and he gets the call in an ultra-competitive nursery. First-time cheekpieces could unlock a bigger performance from Launch Sequence, and he's feared along with Washington Royale, who could still be well treated under a penalty.

  1. PRIDE OF TOLEDO (IRE)
  2. LAUNCH SEQUENCE (IRE)
  3. WASHINGTON ROYALE

races.name: Pertemps Network Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
A wide open finale. FANS FAVOURITE did well to score at Beverley last time and is fancied to rack up a fourth success of 2026 under conditions which really suit and with Oisin Murphy now in the saddle. Almekarem has yet to race on soft going but is weighted to go close on the back of his very good Epsom second so warrants plenty of respect. Last year's victor Something Splendid and in-form duo Everyoneknowsadave and Canvas can also have a say.

  1. FANS FAVOURITE
  2. ALMEKAREM (IRE)
  3. SOMETHING SPLENDID

meeting_summary.going: Hurdle: good to yielding; chase: yielding

races.name: Burke's Clonbur 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
WE'RE OUT OF ACES makes plenty of appeal on paper and wouldn't need to be anything out of the ordinary to get her career off to the perfect start. Divine Believer showed some aptitude for hurdling in a similar event here last month and that's the best form on offer. Misty Cove also has some hurdling experience to call upon and may prove best of the rest.

  1. WE'RE OUT OF ACES (IRE)
  2. DIVINE BELIEVER (IRE)
  3. MISTY COVE (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
THE DOTSKI shaped with definite promise in a pair of maiden hurdles during the second half of last season, paying for a big move into contention when fourth in a Navan maiden in February. Returning to action with her yard amongst the winners and open to further improvement, she shades preference over Willie Mullins' recent course runner-up Ronnie's Rascal and Brave Lady.

  1. THE DOTSKI (IRE)
  2. RONNIE'S RASCAL (IRE)
  3. BRAVE LADY (IRE)

races.name: Michael Cawe Suspended Ceilings Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
TAKE THE FREE arrives on the back of a win and on an upward curve, and looks the one to side with in an open-looking handicap. Luck Between Us is another unexposed sort and represents the chief threat, while Jupiter Du Gite has been threatening to come good and must also be respected.

  1. TAKE THE FREE (IRE)
  2. LUCK BETWEEN US (IRE)
  3. JUPITER DU GITE (FR)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
SHE'LL BE KEPT has been a different proposition since joining her current yard and is taken to defy a further 11 lb rise and complete the hat-trick. The consistent Theflyingbee looks the main danger, while the unexposed Walkingmayotomilan is also one to consider.

  1. SHE'LL BE KEPT (IRE)
  2. THEFLYINGBEE (IRE)
  3. WALKINGMAYOTOMILAN (IRE)

races.name: P&D Lydon Mares Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
CARRIED WITH LOVE looks interesting on her hurdles form and could be worth chancing on stable/chasing debut. Straight Home is feared second time up over fences for Willie Mullins, while Affinity Rock looks to hold rock-solid claims.

  1. CARRIED WITH LOVE (IRE)
  2. STRAIGHT HOME (IRE)
  3. AFFINITY ROCK (IRE)

races.name: Lodge At Ashford Castle Handicap Chase (0-100)
races.verdict:
IL SILENZIO has looked a much-improved performer since being sent chasing and did well to overcome a troubled passage when scoring at Roscommon last month. A 7 lb rise doesn’t look excessive and, with more to come, he makes plenty of appeal. Set The Tone shaped well last time and remains well treated on his hurdles form, so rates the main danger, while the progressive Ladies Well is another to consider.

  1. IL SILENZIO
  2. SET THE TONE (IRE)
  3. LADIES WELL (IRE)

races.name: Adare Manor Opportunity Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
LEAVE IN SECRET went like the best horse at the weights when runner-up at Wexford last time, and he may be able to go one better here. Sayitfirst looks interesting on the pick of her chase form, while Lady Doyanne and Stoneyford Lady both appeal for the excellent Henry De Bromhead yard.

  1. LEAVE IN SECRET (IRE)
  2. SAYITFIRST (IRE)
  3. LADY DOYANNE (IRE)

races.name: John Madden & Sons (Pro-Am) Flat Race
races.verdict:
IRON SWORD sets a reasonably good standard and is fancied to make it third time lucky. Newcomers Le Grand Retour and Gaelic Seer need keeping a close eye on in the betting, however.

  1. IRON SWORD (FR)
  2. LE GRAND RETOUR (IRE)
  3. GAELIC SEER (IRE)

races.name: Prix De La Societe Des Courses De La Chartre-sur-le-loir Handicap
Prix Pmu O Gros L'o Mainvilliers - Monte
Race 2 - Tax Free Shopping Distaff Handicap
Race 5 - Cliff Berry Turf Sprint Handicap
Race 11 - Leader Of The Class Sale Overnight Stakes
